tools.name: parse_user_agent
tools.description: Parse one User-Agent string. Returns browser, engine, OS, device type and CPU (ua-parser-js 1.0.41), and whether it is a known bot, search crawler, AI crawler (with its AI purpose) or an AI agent acting for a user (is_ai_agent, ai_agent_kind fetch | browsing), plus the bot name, operator, robots.txt

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: parse_user_agent · Private data: parse_user_agent · Public sink: parse_user_agent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: parse_user_agent · Private data: parse_user_agent · Public sink: parse_user_agent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
